header.provenance: own-binary: raw PE bytes; current Ghidra entry-point export; match manifest
header.status: leads only; no candidate is promoted to a function by this scan
header.method: maximal mixed CC/90 run ends at a 16-byte-aligned non-CC/90 byte inside .text
limitations: False positives include embedded data and filler-valued instruction operands.
False negatives include unaligned entries, entries without filler and entries starting with CC/90.
Ghidra bounding spans can include holes or have incorrect boundaries.
Includes CRT/third-party regions; candidate count is not an engine-function count.
Neither a function-count upper bound nor a reason to change the progress denominator.
